title: People & Culture Manager
description:
Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.
  
  
  
  
People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

**Job Description**

We are currently seeking a
**People & Culture Manager**
to join our vibrant team.. At RHG , we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.

As a
**People & Culture Manager**
, you infuse our HR team with a unique blend of strategic vision, a commitment to fostering a positive workplace culture, and an unwavering dedication to the personal and professional growth of our talented workforce.

* Ensures the smooth running of the Human Resources Department, where all areas of responsibility are managed and delivered to the highest levels.
* Works proactively to maximize the guest service and the team experience, delivering a positive and responsive approach to enquiries and problem resolution.
* Develops and implements plans where human resources initiatives & hotel targets are achieved.
* Works with key stakeholders, effectively managing and reviewing the life cycle of the team within the hotel, fostering a culture of growth, development and performance.
* Owner of the Human Resources budget and training plan, where together with management, facilitates the evaluation of team performance.
* Builds and maintains effective working relationships with all key stakeholders and business partners.
* Reviews and scrutinizes employee resourcing, compensation, employee development, training and succession plans, providing recommendations that will enhance performance and provide added value to the individual and the company.
* Ensures adherence and compliance to all legislation where due diligence requirements and best practice activities are planned, delivered and documented for internal and external audit, performing follow-up as required.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in HR with strong problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent leadership skills with a hands-on approach and lead-by-example work style.
* Commitment to exceptional guest service with a passion for the hospitality industry.
* Ability to find creative solutions, offering advice and recommendations.
* Personal integrity, with the ability to work in an environment that demands excellence, time and energy.

**Additional Information**

**Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?**

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -**
Be part of a team that creates
**exceptional experiences and memorable moments**
every day. Let your
**Yes I Can!**
spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career -**
No matter your background or experience, we invest in your
**growth, learning, and career development**
—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit -**
Join a workplace that’s
**inclusive, fun, and meaningful**
. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our
**Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**
.

**Lead with Your Ambition -**
Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to
**make a difference**
—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -**
No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Enjoy benefits such as**
- up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide
  
  
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family
  
  
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!**
If you’re ready to
**bring your talent, energy, and passion**
, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all
**backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**
. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

title: Deputy Manager_ Behavioural Learning & Talent Development
description:
Jaquar Group
is a prominent Indian conglomerate established in 1960 that operates in the bathroom and lighting industry headquartered in Manesar and has a global presence with manufacturing facilities, subsidiaries, and distribution networks in various countries. Jaquar has grown to become one of the leading manufacturers of
**premium bathroom fittings, sanitary ware, faucets, showers, wellness products, and lighting solutions.**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Learning & Talent Development professional to drive Jaquar’s behavioural capability-building agenda and strengthen our talent development practices.

The role will partner with business leaders and HRBPs to identify capability needs, design impactful learning interventions, and build development journeys that enable employees and future leaders to grow. The role will also contribute to strengthening talent practices through competency frameworks, assessments, career development initiatives, and early career talent programmes.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of behavioural learning, talent development, and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate business needs into meaningful development solutions.

The role focuses on identifying behavioral development needs, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and measuring the impact of training on individual and organizational performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Behavioural Learning & Capability Building**

* Drive identification of behavioural capability needs through business inputs, performance insights, and competency gaps.
* Design and execute behavioural learning interventions and development journeys aligned with organizational priorities.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and external learning partners to create relevant, engaging, and impactful learning experiences.
* Drive programme effectiveness through learner feedback, assessments, and reinforcement mechanisms.

1. **Talent Development & Competency Management**

* Design and strengthen behavioural competency frameworks aligned with organizational capabilities and career stages.
* Drive competency-based assessments, including multi-rater feedback processes, to support individual development.
* Partner with HRBPs and leaders to identify talent development priorities and create targeted development interventions.
* Support career development and acceleration initiatives to build internal talent pipelines.
* Enable employees to understand career pathways and development opportunities through structured career journeys.

1. **Campus & Early Career Development**

* Own the learning and development journeys for campus talent programmes, including Management Trainees, Sales Executive Trainees, Corporate Executive Trainees, Summer Interns and other early career cohorts.
* Design structured development experiences covering capability building, assessments, mentoring, and career progression.

1. **Stakeholder & Partner Management**

* Collaborate with business leaders, HRBPs, and functional teams to embed learning and development as a business priority.
* Manage relationships with external learning and assessment partners to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Track programme effectiveness and continuously enhance the experience based on feedback and outcomes.

**Key Attributes:**

* Strong experience in behavioural learning, capability building, and talent development.
* Ability to diagnose capability needs and design impactful development solutions.
* Experience with competency frameworks, behavioural assessments, and development programmes.
* Strong stakeholder management and programme management skills.
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with execution excellence.

**Competencies**

* Learning Strategy & Capability Building
* Behavioural Learning Design
* Talent Development & Assessment
* Competency Framework Design
* Career Development & Talent Mobility
* Stakeholder Management & Influencing
* Programme & Project Management
* E-Learning content management
* Role Based Training

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, or related discipline preferred. Certification in psychometric tools/facilitation/coaching would be an added advantage
* 6 to 8 years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience in behavioral learning interventions, competency frameworks, assessments, and talent development programmes.
* Must have exposure to role based trainings, content creation, E-Learning Modules.
* Experience managing external learning partners and assessment providers would be preferred.

title: ARDM
description:
**Company Description**
Kotak Life Insurance Pvt. Ltd. offers career opportunities through this dedicated hiring page for the Recruitment and Development Manager – Tied Agency Channel and similar roles. This page is a standalone platform created specifically for job postings and is not linked to the official Kotak Life website. It is designed to provide clear information on responsibilities, requirements, and application details to help candidates navigate the recruitment process. Applicants seeking broader information about Kotak Life and other career options should refer to the official Kotak Life website.

**Role Description**
As an Associate Recruitment and Development Manager (ARDM) at Kotak Life Insurance Pvt. Ltd., you will focus on building and managing a strong agency network for the Tied Agency Channel. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and recruiting prospective insurance advisors, conducting onboarding sessions, and guiding advisors on sales processes and compliance standards. You will support advisors in achieving their sales targets, monitor their performance, and organize regular training and development activities to enhance productivity. The role also involves collaborating with local leadership to implement business growth plans and ensure excellent customer service. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Sonipat.

**Qualifications**

* Strong recruitment and talent development capabilities, including experience in sourcing, selecting, and mentoring sales or insurance advisors.
* Proficiency in sales, business development, and relationship management, ideally within insurance, financial services, or related sectors.
* Solid communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to engage, motivate, and retain a diverse advisor base.
* Ability to analyze performance data, set targets, and create action plans to drive team productivity and business growth.
* Comfort with basic digital tools and CRM or sales tracking systems for managing leads and reporting activities.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a specialization in business, finance, or marketing is an advantage.
* Prior experience in agency-based insurance sales or team handling roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Self-driven, organized, and willing to work on-site in Sonipat with a focus on ethical, customer-centric practices.

title: Executive - Expat GA Admin [Contract role]
description:
We’re hiring for a leading Japanese MNC in the automotive sector, at their Manesar plant.

**Role:**
Executive - Expat GA Admin

**Experience:**
2-3 years

**Payroll:**
Third-party (please apply only if you’re open to this)

**Location:**
Manesar, work from office

**Apply only if all of these are true for you:**

* You speak Japanese at a working level and have used it at work
* You’ve personally handled visa, FRRO registration or extensions for foreign nationals
* You’ve worked with Japanese managers or in a Japanese company
* You can commute to Manesar daily

**What you’ll do**

Expat management

* Arrange expat accommodation and handle day-to-day repair and maintenance
* Manage expat compliance: visa, FRRO and related legal formalities
* Run onboarding and exit formalities for expatriates

Admin support

* Prepare and maintain MIS reports
* Drive cost-saving initiatives and manage approvals
* Write proposals and simplify admin processes

Working with Japanese management

* Be the link between Japanese expats and local teams
* Work within Japanese corporate culture and management style

**What you bring**

* 2-3 years in admin, with hands-on expat management
* Spoken Japanese with relevant work experience
* Clear communication and presentation skills, comfortable with senior Japanese leaders
* Strong MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Experience writing proposals and improving processes

**Preferred:**
prior experience in a Japanese company or supporting Japanese expats directly.

To apply, send your CV with current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and your Japanese level (JLPT, if certified).

title: Plant HR Manager
description:
**Note:- Please dont apply if you are from coorporate/Staffing we are looking for some who has factory or Plant experince only.**

Job Description – Factory HR Manager

Industry: Cooling Tower Manufacturing

Location: Nuh, Haryana (Onsite)

Department: Human Resources

Designation: Factory HR Manager

Experience: 8–15 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Factory HR Manager to manage the

complete HR and personnel function at our cooling tower manufacturing facility in Nuh,

Haryana. The candidate will be responsible for employee relations, industrial relations,

statutory compliance, payroll coordination, attendance and leave management, training,

and overall factory HR operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in manufacturing or engineering

industries, with the ability to manage shop-floor employees, contract labour,

supervisors, and management staff while ensuring smooth factory operations and

compliance with applicable labour laws.

Required Skills

• Strong knowledge of factory HR operations and manufacturing workforce

management.

• Sound understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, and industrial

relations.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving

skills.

• Ability to manage a diverse workforce and handle shop-floor employee issues

independently.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMIS, attendance systems, and payroll coordination.

• Strong coordination skills with Production, Accounts, EHS, Administration, and

senior management.

• Ability to work in a factory-based environment and manage operational priorities.

Required Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be required:

• Cooling Towers and Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

• Steel, Automotive, EPC, and Process Equipment Manufacturing

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Report to the factory at least 15 minutes before the commencement of factory

operations and leave 15 minutes after factory closing time, ensuring presence

before manpower enters and after manpower exits the premises.

• Share the daily manpower strength report (as per the prescribed format) through

Email and WhatsApp before 10:30 AM every day.

• Contact employees who are absent without prior leave approval to ascertain the

reason for absence and confirm their availability for the next working day.

Similarly, coordinate with contractors to understand manpower shortages and

ensure adequate workforce deployment.

• Ensure that all files, records, registers, certificates, and documents are properly

maintained, updated, secured, and readily available for inspection at all times.

• Plan and coordinate overtime (OT) requirements with the Production and Dispatch

teams for Sundays, holidays, and other operational needs, wherever required.

• Conduct a minimum of 2 rounds daily across all shop floors and open areas to

monitor housekeeping, lighting, maintenance, employee productivity, and overall

discipline. Immediate corrective action must be taken wherever necessary.

• Handle liaison activities with government authorities and external agencies,

including Police, Labour Department, Lawyers, and other statutory bodies.

• Manage deployment of factory manpower to various project sites across India,

including manpower planning, travel arrangements, ticket bookings, and

coordination with Clients, Site In-Charges, and Head Office.

• Ensure complete security of men, material, machinery, and company assets.

Security personnel should be deployed and managed through rotational duties to

prevent theft, pilferage, and unauthorized activities.

• Ensure timely compliance with all statutory requirements related to PF, ESI,

Labour Laws, Health & Safety, Electricity, DG Sets, Environment & Pollution

Control, and other applicable regulations. Maintain all statutory records,

certificates, NOCs/NDCs, and compliance documents in updated condition.

Coordinate periodic health check-ups, X-rays, ultrasounds, and other medical

examinations as recommended by the company doctor.

• Maintain optimum manpower strength in the factory at all times. In case of

manpower shortages, suitable resources should be arranged through available

recruitment channels and sources.

• Perform duties independently and proactively, ensure proper housekeeping and

cleanliness throughout the factory premises, including internal production areas,

offices, open spaces, roads, and external surroundings of factory maintaining a

safe and hygienic working environment.

• Monitor workforce productivity to ensure employees remain engaged in assigned

tasks. Supervisors and Engineers should remain present on shop floors and work

locations where production, assembly, erection, or other operational activities are

being carried out.

• Refrain from involvement in scrap sales, material purchases, or procurement

activities unless specifically authorized by management.

• Oversee maintenance and Annual Maintenance Service (AMS) activities related to

DG Sets, drinking water systems, sewage systems, buildings, roads, open areas,

boundary walls, toilets, electrical infrastructure, fans, air conditioners, lighting,

and ventilation systems. Coordinate with the Factory Caretaker to ensure timely

completion of maintenance activities.

• Recruitment and separation of manpower shall be carried out only after obtaining

concurrence from the Production Manager and Production Coordinator, along with

written approval from the Head Office.

• Any other job as per requirement of company, jobs & responsibilities mentioned

here can be added/deleted/changed at sole discretion of management.

**Regards,**

**Keshav Suman**

**Executive- HR- Talent Acquisition**

**Paltech Cooling Towers & Equipments Ltd.**

**Mob: 9155994824**

**Landline : 0124-4499700**

**Email: hr@paltech.net.in**

title: Intern- Operations Training
description:
Operations Trainer
 



 The role will oversee the operations related training for different functions First Mile, MidMile,
 



 LastMile, FTL Operations, LTL Operations. The core focus will be on performance related
 



 metricstraining, job role related scheduled curriculum training and induction training. The role
 



 alsodemands superior analytics acumen to identify areas / facilities which require extra
 



 emphasis ontraining. The Manager Training will research, design, develop, deliver, and
 



 evaluates traininginitiatives that promote people capabilities throughout the organization. This
 



 role also monitor theeffective roll out of training via 300\+ Ops Coaches in the network.
 



 Oversee the training team of Delhivery Academy by ensuring all the trainers achieve the
 



 KPIs setby the organization.
 



 Plans and coordinates all onsite and virtual training activities of the Ops staff (frontline to
 



 middle\-management) to include resource, calendar and venue coordination, facilitator
 



 preparation, material preparation and/or other logistics related items. Ensures training records
 



 are maintained.
 



 Designs and delivers training \- both face to face and virtual training within time and
 



 budgetconstraints. Working with stakeholders and subject matter experts (SME's) to make
 



 the trainingmore relevant to the business objective.
 



 Monitors and evaluates training programs effectiveness, success, and outcome periodically.
 



 Plan, conduct and oversee Ops metric focused on\-the\-job coaching and scheduled training
 



 toimprove the performance of Ops facilities First Mile, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Returns, FTL
 



 Ops, LTLOps, Fulfillment Ops.
 



 Manages and oversees the learning management system (LMS) learning experience; analyzelearner performance and engagement. Work with team to enact any needed improvements orchanges needed.
 



 Conducts effective induction and orientation sessions.
 



 Communicates with key stakeholders to obtain knowledge and understanding of business needsand operations.
 



 Other duties and responsibilities as determined by Head Delhivery Academy
 



 Travel extensively (PAN India) to various Delhivery facilities as and when required
 



 Interactionswith Internal and External Stakeholders \- This role will interact with both internal
 



 and externalgroups. Responsibilities are multi\-faceted, working with Ops Functional and
 



 Regional Heads, AcademyContent Team, Control Tower Team, Tech, Data Teams, third party
 



 e\-Learning Platform providers, National Skill Development Council etc.
